about: Known, accepted historical findings for tools/security/scan_secrets.js (OPS.70.02, BRIEF_RESUME1 item 1). fingerprint = sha256 of the matched value; the value itself is never stored. An entry only applies in --range scans, to commits in the history before onlyInHistoryBefore; the same value anywhere else is a new finding.
